config.title: Props Drilling

intro.title: Props Drilling
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple React app that passes data from a parent component down through multiple nested child components, demonstrating the concept of 'props drilling.' You will learn how to pass props (properties) step-by-step through a component hierarchy, understanding how data flows in React applications. The core programming concept involves using JavaScript objects (props) to share state and functions between components. You will work with React components, JSX syntax, and functional component props, all within a single JavaScript file using JSX. This hands-on exercise will show you the basics of component communication and the common pattern of passing data through intermediate components.
intro.usecase: Props drilling is a common pattern in React applications where data needs to be passed through multiple intermediate components to reach deeply nested child components. You'll encounter this when building complex UI structures like e-commerce product pages where user selections (size, color) must be passed from top-level filters down to individual product cards, or in dashboard applications where user preferences cascade through sidebar, header, and content panels. This approach works well for small to medium applications but becomes challenging to maintain as component hierarchies grow deeper and more complex.

objectives: Construct a React component hierarchy with three levels of nested components
Initialize and pass data through props from parent to deeply nested child components
Manipulate component structure to demonstrate props drilling patterns
Apply props drilling techniques to share state data across multiple component levels
Configure component props to maintain data flow through intermediate components
Implement a practical example showing both the utility and limitations of props drilling
Update component implementations to illustrate how props drilling affects code maintenance
